description: This file provides an immutable implementation of the EffectedSubjects interface, representing sets of granted and revoked authorization subjects.

classes.name: DefaultEffectedSubjects
classes.description: An immutable class that encapsulates granted and revoked authorization subjects.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DefaultEffectedSubjects with provided granted and revoked collections.

methods.name: getGranted
methods.description: Returns the set of authorization subjects with granted permissions.

methods.name: getRevoked
methods.description: Returns the set of authorization subjects with revoked permissions.
